_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Is tu Player {player_id} ann an geama Liar's Dice le {num_players} cluicheadairean.
Riaghailtean:
- Air do throigh, faodaidh tu:
  1) Dèan tairgse ùr le barrachd àireamh no àireamh àiteach àrd (no an dà chuid) na tairgse làithreach; m.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Gairm an tairgse mu dheireadh le bhith a' clàradh '[Call]'.

Ma gheallas tu:
  - Ma tha àireamh fìor den luach àiteach sin am measg a h-uile dìs nas lugha na an tairgse, tha an neach-tairgse mu dheireadh a' call die aon.
  - Mur eil, tha an gairmiche a' call die aon.
Tha cluicheadair a ruigeas 0 dìs air a dh'fhàgadh a-mach. Tha an cluicheadair mu dheireadh a' bhuannachadh.

board.new_round:
Cuairt ùr - Faodainn a dh'fhàgail: {dice_summary}
Faodainn a tha agad a-nis: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Cluicheach {current_player_id} a' glaodh! An tuigidh fìor de dh'aghaidh {face_value} tha {count}, a tha NAS mhò de {quantity}.
Cluicheach {loser_id} (an neach a chuir an gealltagh mu dheireadh) a' call aon fhaodainn.
call.caller_loses:
Cluicheach {current_player_id} a' glaodh! An tuigidh fìor de dh'aghaidh {face_value} tha {count}, a tha >= {quantity}.
Cluicheach {loser_id} (an glaodhaiche) a' call aon fhaodainn.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Call a dhèanamh gun tairgse ro-làimh.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Gnìomh nach eil aithnichte mar '[Bid: X, Y]' no '[Call]' a tha furasta. Gnìomh a chaidh a chur a-steach: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Tha cainnid ùr {new_quantity} nas ìsle na an t-suidheachadh làithreach {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Tha luach-ainm ùr {new_face_value} nas ìsle na an t-seirbheis làithreach {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Tha an tairgse co-ionann ris a' thairgeadh làithreach.
bid_reason.face_range: Feumaidh luach clàr a bhith eadar 1 agus 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Chaidh cluicheadair {player_id} a thoirt air falbh le gluasad neo-dhligheach.
